eve.text: In Eventide, Oko turns out to be the hidden hand behind an ordeal that fooled Maralen and Rhys. He manipulates Rhys into believing Maralen is becoming Oona, so Rhys strikes her with moonglove.
Oko admits he roused Isilu and turned Rhys against her, then cures his sister Maralen with dawnglow while Eirdu appears to offset Isilu and Rhys is at peace.

eld.text: Oko leaves his home plane intending never to return, and on Eldraine he meets the hedgewitch Alyse, later fathering Kellan, but leaves her after lashing out at the villagers.

Around 4561 AR, Oko and Garruk Wildspeaker kidnap High King Algenus Kenrith, turning him into a stag and disrupting Eldraine's status quo. Oko first arrives on Eldraine and is attacked and wounded by Garruk, then traps him in thorny vines and mesmerizes him into a servile bodyguard called Dog.

At Oko's behest Garruk saves the Kenrith twins from redcaps and kills the High King's guards before Oko kidnaps the king, while Oko disguises himself as Cado and wipes the twins' memory of their encounter.

As the twins chase the Wild Hunt to save their father, Oko, disguised as Ayara, shoots the stag. The murderer is revealed to be Oko in disguise, but Garruk hesitates when Rowan protests, and Oko planeswalks away.

woe.text: Oko plots to eliminate the High King during the Grand Procession to destroy the peace between the elves and the Realm. Oko, in the form of Cado, joins the procession, bewitches the twins, has Garruk kill the guards and kidnaps the king.

He turns the High King into a stag and puts it to sleep, planning to have the Wild Hunt find it, though Queen Ayara finds him suspect when he tries to turn her against humans. The Kenrith twins enter Oko's circle and their memories return, and Elowen sees through him, so he escapes as an eagle.

Oko binds the adventurers in a dome of thorns and walks off with the stag, then, as Queen Ayara, shoots it during the Wild Hunt to incite war. The twins' ice pins him, Rowan forbids Garruk to kill him, and Oko planeswalks away, exiled once the truth comes out and peace returns.

Kellan learns from his mother that his father is the planeswalker Oko, a shapeshifting being who wanted to raze her town after it shunned her. Forty years later Oko returns and the siblings reconcile before Eirdu and Isilu.
Oko's gang also appears on Thunder Junction, where Eriette joins and helps break out Kaervek and Satoru Umezawa.

otj.text: Oko appears on Thunder Junction disguised as a city man, and Annie sees through his illusion with her golden eye, which is exactly why he sought her. He offers her revenge by recruiting her for a heist against the outlaw Akul, but she refuses, until she agrees to join as far as stopping Akul.

Oko announces the crew will rob the vault Maag Taranau, and explains that Bertram Graywater holds the key and the courier Akul chased was a decoy. Oko and Umezawa open a hidden safe and take the sixth key.

On the road Oko meets Kellan, who thinks Oko is his father, and when Sterling guards surround Oko, Kellan saves him with golden vine-shaped magic. Oko decides Kellan should join them, announcing he is his son, and promises to teach him about his heritage.

During the train job, Oko overrules Kellan about helping Umezawa and orders Annie to blow up the bridge, and when it goes wrong he jumps off and abandons the passengers while Kellan tries to stop the train. In Tarnation, Akul's inner circle captures Oko, Kellan, Annie and Vraska, and Akul takes the sixth key from Oko to assemble the full key.

Once the crew is freed, Kellan tosses Akul's fallen medallion back to Oko, who leaves his son behind. Oko admits he leaked Tarnation's coordinates to Graywater to use the raid as a distraction, and that he brought Kellan because he knew he would get them caught, so Kellan joins Ral against him.

ecl.text: In Lorwyn Eclipsed, Oko comes home as a faerie that Maralen greets as her brother, and she explains that he was made a shapeshifter and the blue faerie was his Lorwyn self. The faerie grows into a tall winged man, confronts Rhys and declares Oona dead and Maralen his sister.

Oko recounts leaving Oona and mistaking Maralen for Oona reborn, and reveals that he was Oona's first attempt at an heir. Touched by an elf's sunlit reliquary he turns into his Lorwyn self and transforms elves into an elk and rabbits to protect Sanar.

When Kirol explains that dawnglove may counter moonglow, Oko flies off to find Morcant, and returns to take the vial of dawnglow and vow not to fail his sister. He drips it into Maralen's mouth and she revives, and he tells Rhys that Maralen is not Oona reborn and spares him, since Rhys thought he was destroying a tyrant.
He gives the rest of the dawnglow to Ajani for Tam's wound, and Maralen thanks him for returning. Oko declines to stay and rule, but Maralen offers him a home in Glen Elendra.
